file_stem: RWB E1 044 Database migrations versioned with parameterized schema names
title: Database migrations versioned with parameterized schema names
goal: Every schema change is a forward-only Flyway migration with no literal schema name
why: DEV, SIT, UAT and PROD must hold the same recovery schema. Files are V<seq>__<story>_<name>.sql with ${recoverySchema}; the views ship as V0002 / V0003.
ace_note: No ACE read. It fixes how the 30 views ship: Section A in V0002 (E1-069), Section B in V0003 after RWB-ACE-001. No FK into public.
stores: PostgreSQL test container in the pipeline; P1 job monitor record per run

path.text: Lint: no literal schema, no FK to public

rules: BR2: no literal schema name; use ${recoverySchema} (fixed to recovery)
BR4: PROD is forward-only: clean disabled, no undo files
BR6: its own history table flyway_schema_history_recovery
BR8: no foreign key into public (ADR-010)
risks: An applied file was edited -> checksum fails, service does not start (MSG-P3-016)
Literal schema name in a file -> build fails (MSG-P3-016)
example: -> applied once; version 12 + checksum in flyway_schema_history_recovery
